name: Suzuki GSX-8S / GSX-8R
engine: 776 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, ride-by-wire
intro: Suzuki's 800 twin street bikes. Some early 2024 GSX-8Rs had a drive chain recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2024 GSX-8Rs are in recall 24V081 for a drive chain with missing rivets.
A-002.reason: A chain that comes apart cuts drive to the rear wheel. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Drive chain may be missing rivets and can come apart.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the chain free.
